description: Every abnormal jump or drop of the last 30 days for a coin with its causes and their shares: the story that moved it (with desks and measured realism), a liquidation cascade or forced closes, the whale tracker, the tape, Bitcoin and why Bitcoin moved, US stocks, open interest (deleveraging, short covering, new positioning), the chart structure (a broken level, a new 30-day extreme), with a sentence on every move - unknown said out loud. Pass at (ms) with pct for a live verdict on a move happening now.
